SELECT COALESCE(SUM(net_val), 0) AS total_net_value
FROM (
  SELECT 
    (o.c_mmauea / 100.0) * o.c_zvtndn - COALESCE(r.total_refunds_dollars, 0) AS net_val
  FROM r_tevtah o
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT p.c_hcpfsy
    FROM r_akwdpt p
    INNER JOIN (
      SELECT c_hcpfsy, MAX(c_fwsunx) as max_rev
      FROM r_akwdpt
      GROUP BY c_hcpfsy
    ) latest ON p.c_hcpfsy = latest.c_hcpfsy AND p.c_fwsunx = latest.max_rev
    WHERE p.c_ikfmva = 'North'
  ) current_north_customers ON o.c_zaymmn = current_north_customers.c_hcpfsy
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT c_istkyb, SUM(c_qsjhvn) / 100.0 AS total_refunds_dollars
    FROM r_hqqekt
    GROUP BY c_istkyb
  ) r ON o.c_dzavik = r.c_istkyb
  WHERE o.c_mmauea IS NOT NULL
);
